name.en: Fio Puro Ivory Ribbed Merino Turtleneck Sweater with a Close Fit, Long Sleeves and a Folded Collar

description.en: A ribbed merino turtleneck in ivory, cut close through the body. The folded neck sits high without choking.
description.pt-BR: Gola alta canelada de merino marfim, justa no corpo. A gola dobrada sobe sem apertar.
